decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of high-end speakers from Sony and JBL alongside top-selling budget options like the EDUPLINK. The premium models, including the Sony SRS-XB43 ($156.34) and JBL Pulse 4 ($249.90), are well-rated but exceed my budget for a portable speaker. The EDUPLINK offered impressive specs for under $30, but recent reviews cited disappointing sound quality and concerns about durability. I also considered a renewed JBL Charge 4, but I am hesitant to purchase refurbished electronics where battery life is a critical factor. Much of the product feed consisted of accessories like wall shelves and carrying cases rather than the speakers themselves, which limited the selection of brand-new, mid-priced options. Consequently, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
